difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a functor carrying a final object to a final object and commuting with fibre products, the auxiliary index categories are filtered (statement lines 668-680). The proof is a complete argument: the companion result applies, so the auxiliary categories split into directed components and only connectedness remains to be shown (proof lines 683-691); nonemptiness follows from the final object and the finality of its image (proof lines 694-699); and connectedness is obtained by connecting two objects through the image of the product of their targets (proof lines 702-709). The non-formal content is the reduction and the two verifications. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
